verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers web tools (Document Driver, Capital and Liquidation Calculators) that could plausibly be automated, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows a CLI, API or headless/CI mode. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
